note: Candidates — partial evidence recorded as PROVISIONAL directions. Not authority: consumers may adopt them as marked starting points, never present them as canonical. Promotion requires the evidence named in promote_when (then proposal -> review).

candidates.title: Streak & achievement readouts (provisional)
candidates.summary: Compose streaks and achievements from display numerals plus the ruled register; no rings, badge shapes or trophies.
candidates.evidence_present: Lenient re-classification of the ring/streak/badges decline: compositions stated by adjudication; no live-product instance for the composition chrome.
promote_when: A live-product instance of the composed readout is captured.
Recurrence across at least two consumers.

candidates.title: Paging composition (provisional)
candidates.summary: Outline buttons plus a plain readout (e.g. 'Entrées 9–16 de 24'); no dedicated paging canon exists.
candidates.evidence_present: Lenient re-classification of the view-tabs/paging decline: the paging composition pathway was stated by adjudication; view switching itself stays with the masthead active state (D-08).
promote_when: A live-product pager instance is captured.
At least two consumers need the same composition.

candidates.title: Category word chip (provisional)
candidates.summary: Category as a word chip in the ruled register (D-10 label idiom): plain caps word, 1px rule box, no pictograms, bilingual pair where space allows.
candidates.evidence_present: Lenient re-classification of the pictograms/tags decline: the word-chip composition was stated by adjudication; no live-product chip instance captured.
promote_when: A live-product category chip instance is captured.
Recurrence across at least two consumers.
